_comment: Daily short-form content bank for NihonGo. type 'pitch' = minimal-pair pitch-accent hook (pitch verified against public/pitch-accents.json). type 'grammar' = common learner mistake the AI fixes. Add entries freely; generate-daily.mjs picks one per run.

entries.hook: Your Japanese past tense is WRONG
entries.why: i-adjectives conjugate themselves — never add でした.
〜たい attaches to the verb stem: 行き + たい.

entries.wrong: 私は犬が好きです。私は…
entries.why: Japanese drops the subject once it's known. Don't repeat 私は.
Ongoing state = 〜ている. 住みます sounds like a future plan.

entries.hook: na-adjective negative — most learners miss this
entries.why: na-adjectives negate with じゃない, not くない (that's for i-adjectives).

entries.right: 大好き / すごく好き
entries.why: とても modifies adjectives; for strong liking use 大好き or すごく.
Animals use the counter 匹. Numbers need the right counter, not bare 三.

entries.hook: Stop saying 知ります for 'I know'
entries.why: 'To know' as a current state uses 〜ている: 知っています. 知ります sounds like a future action.

entries.wrong: 友達が私にプレゼントをあげた
entries.right: 友達が私にプレゼントをくれた
entries.why: When someone gives TO you, use くれる — not あげる (which is giving away from you).

entries.hook: ら抜き言葉 — natives notice instantly
entries.why: The potential form of 食べる is 食べられる. Dropping the ら is casual slang, not standard.
〜すぎる attaches to the adjective stem: 高 + すぎる.
For 'looks ~', drop the final い: おいし + そう です.

entries.hook: This counter is irregular and everyone misses it
entries.why: 1 and 2 people are irregular: ひとり, ふたり — never いちじん/にじん.

entries.hook: Your door won't 開ける itself
entries.why: 開ける = someone opens it (transitive); 開く = it opens (intransitive). が takes the intransitive 開く.
na-adjectives + なる use に: 元気になる. 〜くなる is only for i-adjectives (高くなる).
〜たい conjugates like an i-adjective: 行きたいです — never 〜たいだ.

entries.hook: もう vs まだ trips up everyone
entries.why: もう = already (done); まだ = not yet / still. 'Already ate' is もう食べました.

entries.wrong: サッカーをプレイする
entries.why: Sports and games use する: サッカーをする, テニスをする.

entries.right: あまり好きじゃないです
entries.why: あまり pairs with a negative: あまり〜ない = 'not very'. With a positive it's ungrammatical.

entries.hook: Want someone ELSE to do it? Not 〜たい
entries.right: あなたに来てほしいです
entries.why: 〜てほしい = want someone else to do it. 〜たい = want to do it yourself.

entries.hook: Never stack は after も
entries.why: も replaces は/が — you can't stack them. Just 私も.

entries.hook: 上手 takes が, not を
entries.why: Skill words (上手・下手・好き・得意) take が: 日本語が上手です.

entries.hook: na-adjectives need だ before と思う
entries.why: Nouns and na-adjectives add だ before と思う: 便利だと思います.

entries.right: 退屈しています / つまらないです
entries.why: 私は退屈です can read as 'I am a boring person'. For 'I'm bored' use 退屈しています.

entries.hook: 〜に行く needs the stem, not 〜て
entries.why: Purpose 'go to do X' = verb stem + に行く: 食べに行く, 買いに行く.
